sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, Earth Release, Stable

system.description:
You create a layer of crystalline chakra across your body designed to act as a second skin protecting you from powerful blows and crippling attacks.

You gain resistance to Bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage for the duration.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank increase the cost by 3. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, this resistance extends to Earth, Fire, Cold and Wind Damage. If cast at S-Rank, you instead gain immunity to Bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage for the duration.
